Acme Corp Expense Policy. Expenses above 500 USD require written approval from a department head. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days. Business travel must be booked through the approved travel portal.
Acme Corp Access Control Policy. Access follows the principle of least privilege. Access reviews are performed every quarter. Administrator accounts are separate from daily-use accounts.
